skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Sends out a recon drone to scout a single target, directing the ally with the highest ATK to launch a [Follow-up], and recovers HP to self equal to 120% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Reduces the target's max HP for several turns (HP exceeding the new cap is immediately removed). Deals 110% ATK DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Reduces the target's max HP for several turns (HP exceeding the new cap is immediately removed). Deals 140% ATK DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Increases all allies' max HP by 15% for 2 turns. When an ally in the same column is a Monster, Gyoro-Gyoro shares a portion of the damage they take (stops sharing once their HP falls below a threshold).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Increases all allies' max HP by 20% for 2 turns. When an ally in the same column is a Monster, Gyoro-Gyoro shares a portion of the damage they take (stops sharing once their HP falls below a threshold).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Increases all allies' max HP by 25% for 2 turns. When an ally in the same column is a Monster, Gyoro-Gyoro shares a portion of the damage they take (stops sharing once their HP falls below a threshold).

effects.desc: Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
